description: The Seed skill pack for Claude: raise money for your startup

plugins.name: seed-skill
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for raising a seed round: a competitor scout, an investor finder, a business planner, a pitch deck designer, a closer that drafts outreach and books investor calls (nothing sends without your yes), a market sizer, a financial modeler, a pitch coach, a term sheet reader, a data room builder and investor updates.
